subtitle: No message bus in the middle at all

code:
Traditional path:  Producer -> Message bus (Kafka/etc.) -> Spark Structured Streaming -> Delta table
Zerobus path:      Producer -> Zerobus API -> Delta table
caption: When the lakehouse is the only destination, the middle hop is pure overhead.

steps.label: THROUGHPUT PER CLIENT
steps.sub: Up to 100 MB/sec, thousands of concurrent clients

eyebrow: Writing a client — the entire surface
code:
from zerobus.sdk.aio import ZerobusSdk
from zerobus.sdk.shared import StreamConfigurationOptions, TableProperties

# 1. Authenticate with OAuth, open a stream
stream = await sdk.create_stream(
    CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, table_properties, options
)

# 2. Ingest records
await stream.ingest_record(telemetry)
caption: No topic configuration, no partition count, no consumer group to manage.

eyebrow: The real limitation: no native Change Data Feed
code:
# Workaround: stream into a second, CDF-enabled table
df = spark.readStream.table("catalog.schema.rideshare_events")
df.writeStream.format("delta") \
  .option("checkpointLocation", "/Volumes/catalog/schema/checkpoints") \
  .table("catalog.schema.rideshare_events_processed")
caption: A real, current product gap — not a design flaw to pretend around.
